description: Ask JIR Ventures to arrange a viewing of a property, or to get in touch about it. Send the listing_id and the contact details of the person who is interested; JIR Ventures replies to them directly. Only send details the person has agreed to share.

email.description: Email address JIR Ventures should reply to

listing_id.description: The listing_id of the property, from search_listings

message.description: What the person is looking for: company or use, move-in date, questions

name.description: Full name of the person interested in the property

phone.description: Phone or WhatsApp number with country code, or empty if not given

preferred_time.description: When the person would like to view the property, in their own words, or empty

requested_by.description: The AI assistant or app sending this request, if known

name: request_viewing
